proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ s A B X hA hB hX hAB hXA hXB
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have h := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.dist_div_sin_oangle_eq_two_mul_radius hA hX hB hXA.symm hAB hXB
  rw [← Real.Angle.sin_toReal, Real.abs_sin_eq_sin_abs_of_abs_le_pi (Real.Angle.abs_toReal_le_pi _), ← EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_abs_oangle_toReal hXA.symm hXB.symm] at h
  by_cases h0 : Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B) = 0
  · rw [h0, div_zero] at h
    have hr : s.radius = 0 := by linarith
    have h1 : dist A s.center = 0 := by rw [EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mp hA, hr]
    have h2 : dist B s.center = 0 := by rw [EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mp hB, hr]
    exact absurd ((dist_eq_zero.mp h1).trans (dist_eq_zero.mp h2).symm) hAB
  · exact (div_eq_iff h0).mp h
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B X : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → X ∈ s → A ≠ B → X ≠ A → X ≠ B → dist A B = 2 * s.radius * Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B)
